title: Ceramics Artist In Residence (2026/27)
cost_text: $700-1000/month for housing, plus materials and firing fees
summary: An 8-month immersive ceramics residency (Oct 2026–May 2027) with 24/7 access to fully equipped studios including wood, gas, and soda kilns. Residents live on-site and participate in community, teaching, and exhibition opportunities.
commitment: October 5, 2026 – May 21, 2027 (8 months); 4 hours/week work study
source_quote: Kilns: 2 Electric, 2 Gas, Wood (train), and Wood/Soda (catenary arch) — one of the few women-run woodfire kilns in the county.
evidence_sentence: The ceramics residency page lists wood (train kiln), wood/soda (catenary arch), gas, and electric kilns available to residents.
evidence_quote: Kilns: 2 Electric, 2 Gas, Wood (train), and Wood/Soda (catenary arch) — one of the few women-run woodfire kilns in the county.
